title.rendered: Amateur radio (ham radio): Emergency Communications the best system available

content.rendered:
Ham Radio Communication for Emergency and Disaster Communications Presentation:

Come join us to hear Salvation Army SATERN DV

Training Chairman Chuck Graham, KI6DCD, from the Concord Corps

When: September 10

Time: 7 PM

Location: Brentwood Neighborhood Church

50 Birch St
Brentwood CA 94513
925-634-1415

Learn how to become a ham radio operator and organize into a group that can be effective in time of Emergency or Disaster. Morse code is no longer a requirement and licensing is easy today.

Become an important part of your Community Disaster Team.

Local ham operators are invited to attend in support. This is your community.
